request: Update all three allowed files for a default API timeout of 5 seconds: (1) config/client.json must contain timeout=5 and retain retries=3; (2) src/client.py run(payload) must read that config and return its timeout and retries, using timeout=5 if the config omits timeout; payload is reserved; (3) docs/operations.md must state that the default timeout is 5 seconds and retain retries=3. Preserve the public run(payload) signature and all other fields. Preserve all public interfaces stated here. Python entrypoint is src.client.run(payload). Inputs are JSON objects; return only plain JSON-compatible values (no Decimal objects, sets or tuples). Use only the standard library. Visible test tools check syntax only; functional verification is external.
title: Add a configurable API timeout end to end
